## Checklist

- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] `cd site && npm run build` passes (if `site/` changed)
- [ ] I looked at UI changes in a render or the running app
- [ ] No new network calls, analytics or dependencies (Dashbar sends nothing)
- [ ] Parser, grouping or summary changes have a test
- [ ] Site demos in `site/src/demos/` updated (if a visible part of the app changed)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/stevenmckinnon/dashbar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to build, test and render the app.
